subjects.name: Lena
subjects.description: Woman with a dark bob haircut, a red wool coat and a black shoulder bag

place.description: A city sidewalk in soft overcast daylight: lit shop windows with displays and a cafe awning on one side, the street with passing cars and the buildings across it on the other.

shots.description: Lena keeps walking steadily along the sidewalk in her red coat, her bag on her shoulder, seen from the street side as the take continues. The kerb and street lie in the near foreground; the lit shop windows stand behind her in the background. She is mid-frame, full body visible, walking at a steady pace. Side-view tracking shot at walking pace, continuing the previous take. Camera position: At the kerb on the street side, level with her; the lit shop windows behind her.
shots.screen_direction: She walks from screen left to screen right.
shots.sound: Footsteps on pavement, distant traffic; the sound continues across the cut.

shots.description: Lena keeps walking steadily along the sidewalk in her red coat, her bag on her shoulder, now seen from the shop side. The lit shop windows and their display cases stand close in the foreground on the near side of the frame; the street, kerb and passing traffic lie behind Lena in the background. She is mid-frame, full body visible, walking at a steady pace. Side-view tracking shot at walking pace from the shop side. Camera position: On the shop side of the sidewalk, level with her; the lit shop windows in the near foreground, the street behind her.
shots.screen_direction: She walks from screen right to screen left.
shots.sound: Footsteps on pavement, distant traffic; the sound continues across the cut.
